MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The J-B Weld epoxy felt useful because my repair tape and vinyl cement purchases make a durable repair adhesive a natural next choice.",
    "The smaller hose clamps matched my repeated purchases of adjustable clamps, provided their diameter fits the hose I need to secure."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Cutting wheels, threaded inserts, and a thread checker require particular projects that I do not currently have; occasional repair work alone does not give me a reason to choose them.",
    "The fixed-size nuts require a confirmed fit, while 100 nuts or ten tubes of glue exceed my current needs. An appealing repair purpose does not make every size or quantity useful.",
    "Wire connectors and an inspection camera do not establish a present need for electronic cleaner or a surface-temperature tool. Those solve different problems."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seemed to be treated as broad interest in workshop supplies, although I choose items for specific repair needs.",
    "My adhesive purchases seemed to suggest that any glue package would appeal to me, without enough attention to its intended use and quantity."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Repeated hose-clamp purchases give me a clearer reason to consider another clamp than unrelated hardware, but the usable diameter still matters.",
    "My history includes both bulk supplies and a travel-size tape, so quantity depends on the task; a past bulk purchase does not mean I need large packs of everything."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair needs but stretched them into interest in tools and supplies without a clear current use or confirmed fit."
}
